What changed: all 3 close zones (BTC's sell, ETH's two) already triggered and broke their stop with no reclaim, now marked broken; BTC rose to 77,886.86 in London and pulled back below its broken zone, ETH rose harder to 2,309 (the day's high) after first sweeping its floor zone broken to the downside. The confirmed trend checklist lost direction on both (from short to no direction). NQ/ES open NY with an early, unconfirmed bullish regime tilt, clawing back part of yesterday's drop: ETH tracked it strongly and outran it, BTC only half-followed (rose in London, already gave back almost all of it). Open interest falling on both: the push was position closing, not fresh money. Add a geopolitical/oil shock from the last hour (risk window until 15:20 UTC), not changing the verdict. Context risk stays HIGH on the hacks (the EU theft now estimated at $133M).
